p01-pipeline-p.text: Divide the travel distance by stride, then count the starting position. $2\times2$ pooling at stride $2$ halves each side.
p01-pipeline-p.name: p01-pipeline-p

p01-pipeline-cnt.text: Values: $784\to4704\to1176\to1600\to400$. Convolution expands the count; pooling reduces it.
p01-pipeline-cnt.name: p01-pipeline-cnt

p01-pipeline-q.text: Input $28\times28\times1$. Conv1: $6$ kernels, $5\times5$, padding $2$. Pool1: $2\times2$, stride $2$. Conv2: $16$ kernels, $5\times5$, no padding. Pool2 repeats Pool1. Find each shape.
p01-pipeline-q.name: p01-pipeline-q

p02-params-title.name: p02-params-title

p02-params-p.text: Each of $c_{\mathrm{out}}$ kernels has $k\cdot k\cdot c_{\mathrm{in}}$ weights and one bias.
p02-params-p.name: p02-params-p

p02-params-p2.text: Every input connects to every output. Add one bias per output.
